description: Build a best-effort single auto-compose transaction for a target portfolio. Charges the configured compose fee when SOLKNIFE_FEE_ACCOUNT is set.

owner.description: A Solana address in base58, 32-44 chars.

targets.description: The desired portfolio: each mint and its share in basis points, summing to 10000.

bps.description: This target's share of the portfolio in basis points (10000 = 100%). All targets must sum to 10000.

mint.description: A Solana address in base58, 32-44 chars.

name: solknife_portfolio_compose_build
